tips.text: Hit the daily cap with raw affinity at dense nodes like Hydron, Adaro or Steel Path, then stop.
Hunt Seeds with Loot Radar on frame and companion, a vacuum companion and a wide-AoE frame.
Stay pledged to New Loka while you earn; only The Perrin Sequence also feeds its standing, and at half the rate.
Decide early if you care about Cephalon Suda; every New Loka point costs it the same amount.
Standing is the easy grind: pledge, cap daily while playing normally, and nobody reports regretting it.
